podcast.body: This song is the opening track from Bad Religion's 1980 debut EP. The EP was self-released on their newly formed indie label, Epitaph Records, after facing rejections from other labels. "it all began with a song called Bad Religion. Bad Religion from their 1980 debut EP issued on their own Epitaph records."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This track was Side One, Track One from Bad Religion's self-titled EP, which marked the inaugural release on their own Epitaph label in February 1981. It was the first song anyone heard from the band when their EP debuted. "Bad Religion with a song called, Bad Religion. The first thing anyone ever heard when they released their first self-titled EP on their own Epitaph label in February of 1981."
